content.comment_body: I have installed a sensor to read an input, and this input is supposed to activate a piston valve. My issue is that the valve will also be triggered in the next two cycles. How can I retain the input in memory and use it to control the output in the subsequent two cycles? I am using [product_name] [version_no] [article_no]. Any advice is appreciated.

Hello [user_name], You could use a latching relay (flipflop) block to store a single-bit memory. For more detailed guidance on this block, you can get helpful information from your [product_name] software by right-clicking on the block and selecting Help. I've attached an example and hope it helps. If it doesn't, please provide a detailed sequence of your machine's operation. Regards, [user_name]
